lines: Every Issue Takeaway: Fried chicken, burgers and pizza, in Nottingham.
Tuesday to Thursday and Sunday: 12 noon till 11pm. Monday: 10pm till 12 noon. Friday and Saturday: 12 noon till midnight.
We take orders by phone for collection and delivery, for today, as soon as possible or for a time later on. Orders are paid when you collect.
Our chicken is halal; our other meat is not.
We cook in a shared kitchen and fryers, so we can't rule out traces of any allergen.
28 items on the menu in 6 sections, and 1 meal deal.
